value.title: Coder u5 — lifecycle: close + reap

sections.name: mission
sections.value: Build exactly u5: `close <id>` owner-only tombstone; `reap [--dry-run]` over proc{pid,proc_start}+pane using existing liveness ports; refuses recycled pid; counts before/after. No product scope decisions; ask PM.

value.text: FIRST set cwd /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fs3-rs-governance-port-u5; ABSOLUTE paths for all file tools because spawn root is main. Load BOTH pij and builder skills. Read this packet, your impl-guide row, and canonical governance routes/events JSON before proposing changes.

Canary + ACK before code: run pij whoami and quote exact output, quote actual OMP footer model/effort, then numbered implementation plan and evidence-backed seam questions via pij_send to pij-lonely-ikrie. Model is github-copilot/gpt-6-astra-1m high on OMP. Wait for PM to rule ack.

Author named baseline-compatible HTTP/CLI regressions and unit tests FIRST. Consume canonical contract fixtures rather than restating schemas. No compile-error-only RED; regression must run against old route behavior. PM owns RED/GREEN execution receipts.

CONCURRENT EDIT WAVE: skip every build/test/formatter/linter/harness boot/check and do not commit. Implement source/tests, then report READY_TO_VALIDATE with exact commands and a snap-in recipe and HOLD. PM validates after every editing seat pauses, composes, and commits. READY is not DONE.

Stay in your owned fence. Migration owner for this unit: 0016 only if necessary; use existing SqliteOrchestration/shared pool, never duplicate SQL in daemon/core. PM owns all common lib.rs/module/Route/Services/CLI wiring and dependency metadata.

Follow governance-routes.json#isolation for any later runtime proof: private port/state-dir/HOME/Claude+XDG homes/TMUX socket for daemon AND clients. Never main writes, main node_modules writes, npm install/ci in main, port7461 fixtures, global links/settings writes, production restart/bounce, flowspace3 daemon, or omp update. Never inspect pij inbox logs.

Use flowspace3 search before meaning-shaped discovery (client only), exact grep for identifiers, LSP for symbols but scope-check: worktree LSP can index main and falsely return zero refs. Record friction with harness observe; never drain or clear buffers.
Report start/end via pij-rs report now; messages via pij_send to PM. OMP may misroute live parent messages into internal scouts: explicitly relay to main context. Do not infer silence means approval.

READY receipt assets/receipt-u5.json includes changed paths, constructor signatures/call order/CLI Route match arms, named tests and pre-fix RED strategy, toolchain versions, and ASSUMPTIONS about sibling state/order/ownership. No stubs, fake fallbacks, unimplemented subverbs, or undocumented scope cuts.

Close is only a tombstone (self/current parent), not process or pane termination. Emit stamped reason through shared bus. Reap uses known proc dead OR proc_start mismatch AND known recorded-pane absence; paneless seats use process alone. Any unknown is a veto and reported unverifiable; no age retention policy.

Use existing liveness ports and recycled-pid fixture. Never signal replacement process. Dry-run writes neither rows nor events; actual run reports before/after and same candidates under same observations. Re-check incarnation before destructive commit to avoid tombstoning a concurrent revive.

Dedicated PIJ_TMUX_SOCKET/refuse-start guard is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE by prime ruling. Use the complete isolation recipe; do not broaden lifecycle into global daemon/toolchain changes. PM cross-unit composition proof is parent-owned.
The PM is your interface: acks, questions, done reports. You never message prime or Jordan directly unless the PM's seat is dead.
DEFER to the PM: interface changes (they affect sibling units), dependency additions, schema/migration changes, anything outside your paths.
Your evidence outranks the packet: if the brief is wrong, say so at ack or stop-and-ask with the measurement — do not silently code around it.

Named baseline-compatible regression plus exact PM validation commands; READY_TO_VALIDATE never implies green.
After edit barrier PM executes proof, composes, and runs full harness checks; production and chainglass are prime-owned.
Complete snap-in recipe + assumptions + changed paths + unharvested buffer supplied; no own merge/deploy.
